phases.name: Start of Round
phases.summary: In Rounds 2-5, discard the three leftmost face-up Main Orders, slide the remaining two left and refill the display to five; refill Tech displays and ready once-per-round abilities.

phases.name: Work Phase
phases.summary: Players alternate placing one worker and resolving that location until all have passed. A worker may be placed only if it can perform at least one instance of that location's main action. At the end of the phase, in First Player order, each player who used a Kiln Yard Shifu may reposition 1 Shared-Kiln ceramic.

phases.name: Firing Phase
phases.summary: If either Shared or Imperial Kiln contains ceramics, resolve Test Pieces, secret Contributions (including secret Fuel Ledger commitments), Base Heat, Fire, Actual Heat, Kiln abilities, Quality, after-Quality Techs and the optional 2-Coin discard of a still-Flawed ceramic.

phases.name: Order Phase
phases.summary: In reverse turn order, each opportunity completes at most one held or face-up Order or passes. Continue until a full circuit has no completion. Each Crown advances Imperial Recognition by one.

phases.name: Cleanup
phases.summary: Return workers and discard held Orders down to the limit of 3. If the round was not the fifth, pass First Player clockwise and advance the round.
